Minimal accurate small English labels only: KEY, BOUNCE, CAMERA, FLAG and PRACTICAL where present. No title, no long text, no numbers, no watermark. NEUTRAL SINGLE PORTRAIT. One upright grey bust/mannequin at center, facing the small camera at front edge. An opaque matte black FLAG to camera-right near shadow side absorbs light. No rim light and no background practical. Show a convincing nose shadow consistent with the softbox. Labels KEY on the panel, BOUNCE on the pale card, FLAG on black panel, CAMERA on camera.

edit_prompts: Correct this lighting-instruction image while preserving the soft clay architectural-render style, seated adult mannequin, table, cool doorway and small foreground camera. CRITICAL: the white panel at camera-left must be an OPAQUE WHITE REFLECTOR, not a translucent diffuser. Move the warm lamp onto the SAME SIDE of the reflector as the seated subject and camera: place lamp low near the front-left corner of the table and point it LEFT toward the white reflector, away from the subject. The lamp illuminates the reflector's visible right-facing surface, and light BOUNCES BACK RIGHT from that same surface onto the subject's face. Show exactly two thin arrows forming a clear angled V with its vertex on the white reflector: arrow from lamp to reflector, then arrow from reflector to face. No arrow or light passes through the reflector. The path from lamp to reflector must not cross the camera. Label lamp PRACTICAL, white reflector KEY / BOUNCE, camera CAMERA. REMOVE the black FLAG and its label completely. Preserve soft warm light on left-facing cheek and restrained shadow on other cheek, and weak cooler light from doorway. Keep the scene uncluttered and full fixtures within frame. Landscape 3:2. No additional text.
